
---
applyTo: "**/*.{server.js,controller.js,service.js,route.js,prisma}"
---

# BACKEND RULES

- Inspect only the relevant endpoint or service.
- Reuse existing middleware and utilities.
- Preserve existing API contracts.
- Do not redesign database schemas without permission.
- Do not modify unrelated endpoints.
- Avoid unnecessary dependency installation.
- Check only relevant tests.
- Keep changes minimal.
